Files with identical bytes are grouped automatically; a PDF and a photo of the same document are merged after someone confirms them against the images. A group is assigned a split by hash when it gets its first sample (about 80% training, 20% validation) and keeps it. If merging or splitting affects groups already exported, possibly with copies in both splits, the group is quarantined, no longer exported, and the affected exports are marked.
